posts.author: SakuraMiya
posts.body: I'm making a game in rpg maker MV. The problem is when I save the files, they end up somewhere in Disc C instead of the save folder. I transferred all data to a new file and seems the problem happens when I move the plugins and/or data maps. Why is this happening?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Means you have a plugin that changes the save path.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
If you're sending the file to the root, it's because some function has been changed. If the problem persists after disabling the plugins, it's because you modified one of the files in the JS folder. This isn't the first time I've seen someone do this and forget about it. Here's the same situation:
MV - load error
Hi all,  First i did do a search and found a few other posts but none of them helped.  Im trying to run a test on a game but get a failed to load:img/faces/Harold.png error message, this images is in the folder and was generated by the RPG Maker MV Character creator and then exported out for...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
I believe this solution will work for you as well. Good luck
